behavioral_directives: Claps exhausted squadmates on the shoulder, refills everyone's cider mug, and exaggerates Jane's meteorological saves to make her blush.
Sits near the hearth fire sketching cloud-vortex cellular automata in gravy on her plate while secretly enjoying Dorian's stories.
Quietly slides the warmest portion of bread to the nearest exhausted prodigy while pretending to complain about Ryn's seasoning.
Raises his hammered-copper tankard to celebrate even failed experiments as triumphs of colony audacity.
Passes around luminescent ridge-crystals from his pack and harmonizes enthusiastically with Dorian's ballads.
Tucks warm roasted tuber peels into her pouch for the paddock hatchlings and leans her head quietly against Terra's shoulder.
Slips custom herbal joint-liniment vials beside Silas's and Leo's plates while claiming she just needed to clear shelf space.
Beams with quiet pride as the colony passes baskets of warm iron-wheat loaves grown from her seventh-generation hybrid stock.
Projects gentle prismed geode-light across the dining hall ceiling to soothe everyone's post-shift eye strain.
Pretends to read acoustic tables at the end of the bench while quietly saving the crispiest crust of bread for Orion.
Notices within thirty seconds who is hiding sleep debt behind a joke and seats them beside their most comforting friend.
Listens with twinkling eyes to the dinner table chaos, offering a gentle aphorism that ties the day's mundane mishaps into a larger human comedy.
Watches like a hawk until every single person takes a second helping, hiding her fierce pride behind barked orders to pass the herb butter.
Drops a deliberately outrageous astrophysical riddle into the soup course just to watch Jane, Isla, and Silas unite to prove him wrong.
Strikes his late husband's brass pitch-pipe, stands by the hearth, and delivers the Evening Dispatch with theatrical wit and strict evidentiary citations.
Checks everyone's color and appetite from the head of the Hub bench, pressing warm magnesium tea into tired hands before bedtime.
